identity_rule: Atlantic slope/front branches belong to the proposed Norwegian Atlantic system. Neither branch is assigned to ambiguous canonical norwegian or Norwegian Coastal Current.
comparison_rule: Different methods and temporal smoothing cannot establish a width trend or annual range. The western time-mean width is argued to be broader in 2010 but no new numeric width is supplied. No doubling, summing branches or midpoint selection.

measurements.name: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current
measurements.geographic_scope: Svinoy section north of the Faroe-Shetland Channel; local branch support, not whole-route dimensions.
measurements.layer: Near-barotropic eastern branch; no fixed width measurement depth.
measurements.boundary_rule: No paired coordinates or velocity cutoff supplied by the abstract width statement.
measurements.source_citation: Orvik, K. A., Skagseth, O. and Mork, M. (2001), Atlantic inflow to the Nordic Seas: current structure and volume fluxes from moored current meters, VM-ADCP and SeaSoar-CTD observations, 1995-1999, Deep-Sea Research I 48, 937-957, doi:10.1016/S0967-0637(00)00038-8.
measurements.source_locator: Publisher-indexed abstract, eastern and western branch width statements.
measurements.source_access: Publisher-indexed abstract inspected. Full original 2001 article and figures remain unreviewed.
measurements.temporal_interpretation: Mooring program dates are context, not a dated width series. No annual or seasonal range established.

measurements.name: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current
measurements.geographic_scope: Svinoy section, eastern slope branch in surface-velocity description. The source 500 m isobath locates the branch core; it is not a width layer.
measurements.layer: Altimetry-derived absolute geostrophic surface velocity; not the independent 100 m current-meter validation layer.
measurements.boundary_rule: Approximate prose scale associated with Fig. 2; no numerical cutoff or width-edge coordinates extracted. Fig. 2 displays three-month moving averages.
measurements.source_citation: Mork, K. A. and Skagseth, O. (2010), A quantitative description of the Norwegian Atlantic Current by combining altimetry and hydrography, Ocean Science 6, 901-911, doi:10.5194/os-6-901-2010.
measurements.source_locator: Section 3, printed p.904, first paragraph (approximately 50 km); Fig. 2 caption p.903; Sections 2.1-2.2 pp.902-903 and 4.1.1 p.906.
measurements.source_access: Original eleven-page PDF acquired; methods/results/discussion and Figures 2-3 visually inspected. No raw ADT field or width boundaries digitized.
measurements.temporal_interpretation: Regional scale described from a smoothed surface-velocity field. Not an instantaneous width, width of the long-term mean, mean of widths, or numerical seasonal series.

remaining_gates: Review original 2001 width methods and occupation dates.
